description_en: Converts an existing classic Tair memory-enhanced instance into the first sub-instance of a distributed instance
description_zh: 将一个存量的Tair内存型（经典版）实例转换为分布式实例中第一个子实例
name: CreateGlobalDistributeCache

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source instance
parameters.name: seed_sub_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group.

This is a system parameter. You do not need to specify it
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。
系统参数无需传入
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies when to perform the operation. Valid values:

Immediately: Performs the operation immediately.

MaintainTime: Performs the operation during the maintenance window. This is the default value.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to change the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
执行时间，取值：
Immediately：立即执行。
MaintainTime：在可维护时间段执行，默认值。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html接口修改实例的可维护时间段
